label: s2_sub_011_girl_01
text: Alola, friend! I’m a big fan of Pokémon from the\nAlola region!

label: s2_sub_011_girl_02
text: Do you have an Alolan Golem in your party\nor Boxes? If so, I’d sure love to see it!

label: s2_sub_011_girl_03
text: I just can’t seem to find an Alolan Golem...

label: s2_sub_011_girl_04
text: That...that’s not a Golem at all!

label: s2_sub_011_girl_05
text: That’s a Golem, yes, but...it’s a regular one!\nWhat I’m looking for is an ALOLAN Golem!

label: s2_sub_011_girl_07
text: Just look at those curious protrusions above its\nhead! And its handsome eyebrows—its full beard!

label: s2_sub_011_girl_08
text: It evolves when it’s traded, you know. I suppose\nthat’s why it’s not often found in the wild...

label: s2_sub_011_girl_09
text: As thanks, let me teach you a pose that’s just\nperfect to show your love for Alolan Golem!

label: s2_sub_011_system_01
text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Electrium Z emote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from the girl!

label: s2_sub_011_girl_npc
text: The hand positions are KEY for the pose I taught\nyou. And you gotta say “Alola” nice and loud!
